questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if

they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

statements.

Statements:

No bench is chair.

All sofas are benches.

All tables are sofas.

Conclusions:

I. No table is a chair.

II. Some sofas are chairs.

III. All tables are benches.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74b2e62927ee0e9de4bd4b8fe7dda1391c69a86d04db866ded83349d6cba3218.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No table is a chair → Follow (As no bench is chair, all sofas are benches and all tables are sofas. As whole tables comes in sofas which whole comes in benches which cannot be chair, therefore it is true.)

II. Some sofas are chairs → Does not follow (As no bench is chair and all sofas are benches. As whole sofas comes in benches which cannot be chair, therefore it is false.)

III. All tables are benches → Follow (As all sofas are benches and all tables are sofas. As whole tables comes in sofas which whole comes in benches, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(25, 300, 6)

(19, 342, 9)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

(25, 300, 6)

__25 × 6** × 2**__ = 300 

300 = 300 (LHS = RHS)

And,

(19, 342, 9)

__19 × 9 × 2__ = 342 

342 = 342 (LHS = RHS)

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) (17, 476, 7)

__17 × 7 × 2__ = 476 

238 ≠ 476 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 2) (24, 600, 5)

__24 × 5 × 2__ = 600 

240 ≠ 600 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Option 3) (18, 288, 8)

__18 × 8 × 2__ = 288 

288 = 288 (LHS = RHS)

Option 4) (14, 364, 7)

__14 × 7 × 2__ = 364 

196 ≠ 364 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Thus, out of all the options, '(18, 288, 8)' follows the same logic as given.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two numbers (not digits) should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

72 - 6 + (18 ÷ 4) + 17 - (22 × 2) = 44
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

Given: By interchanging *'*6 and 4' and checking the option:

Option 4) 72 - 6 + (18 ÷ 4) + 17 - (22 × 2) = 44

After interchanging '6 and 4':

⇒ 72 - 4 + __**(18 ÷ 6)**__ + 17 - __**(22 **____**×**____** 2)**__ = 44

⇒* ****72*** - 4__** + 3 + 17**__ - 44 = 44

⇒ 92 **__- 4 - 44__** = 44

⇒ 92 - 48 = 44

⇒ 44 = 44

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
